unruled:gate:ny_it201.federal_care.reason: The gate is the federal credit's own condition (the New York credit follows the federal one); the findings are about the federal questions' wording, or read their labels for their prompts. The wording findings that hold are registered against f2441.care (BUG-0447), the federal form's lane.

findings.class: not a defect: the prompts include the spouse
findings.evidence: The filer answers the federal questions' prompts, not their short labels: f2441.care asks "did you (or your spouse, if filing jointly) pay for, or incur expenses for, the care of a qualifying person — your child under age 13, or a dependent or spouse who was not able to care for themselves — so that you (and your spouse) could work or look for work?", and f2441.benefits "Did you (or your spouse, if filing jointly) receive dependent care benefits for 2025 — amounts shown in box 10 of a Form W-2, or an amount from your 2024 dependent care plan that you used in 2025 during a grace period?" (forms/2025/f2441.yaml).

findings.class: not a defect: the label is not asked
findings.evidence: ny_it201.federal_care is computed from the two federal answers; its label, with "(federal Form 2441)", is never shown to the filer, and the federal prompts do not ask whether Form 2441 was filed.

findings.class: not a defect: the prompt names them
findings.evidence: The filer answers the federal questions' prompts, not their short labels: f2441.care asks "did you (or your spouse, if filing jointly) pay for, or incur expenses for, the care of a qualifying person — your child under age 13, or a dependent or spouse who was not able to care for themselves — so that you (and your spouse) could work or look for work?", and f2441.benefits "Did you (or your spouse, if filing jointly) receive dependent care benefits for 2025 — amounts shown in box 10 of a Form W-2, or an amount from your 2024 dependent care plan that you used in 2025 during a grace period?" (forms/2025/f2441.yaml). A disabled spouse or a dependent not able to care for themselves is named in the care prompt.
The care prompt gives no examples of care (day camp, before- or after-school programs, a household employee); recorded in BUG-0447 for f2441.care.

findings.class: not a defect: the prompt names box 10
findings.evidence: The filer answers the federal questions' prompts, not their short labels: f2441.care asks "did you (or your spouse, if filing jointly) pay for, or incur expenses for, the care of a qualifying person — your child under age 13, or a dependent or spouse who was not able to care for themselves — so that you (and your spouse) could work or look for work?", and f2441.benefits "Did you (or your spouse, if filing jointly) receive dependent care benefits for 2025 — amounts shown in box 10 of a Form W-2, or an amount from your 2024 dependent care plan that you used in 2025 during a grace period?" Care while a spouse was a full-time student or disabled: the care prompt says "so that you (and your spouse) could work or look for work"; i2441 p. 2 item 2 and IT-216-I p. 1 treat a student or disabled spouse separately. Recorded in BUG-0447 for f2441.care; the federal credit is lost the same way.
